title: Compliance: a commit may cite only an open, claimed task (not a closed one)
goal: check-workflow-compliance.sh currently accepts a commit whose Task trailer names any task closed at the branch head, so unrelated work can ride on a closed task. Evaluate each commit against its own tree: the task must be open there; then it passes if a live claim exists, or if the branch went on to close it. A commit that cites a task already closed at that commit fails. Update the commit-msg hook, Mandate 50 text and AGENTS.md to match.
